Maptitude Named a Best GIS and Mapping Software Tool of 2026 in G2 Buyer's Guide

2026-07-28 Industry Press Release / Geo Week News Maptitude, G2, GIS software, territory mapping, demographic analysis, geocoding, Caliper Corporation, location intelligence
Read the source article

Quick summary

Maptitude by Caliper Corporation has been named one of the six best GIS software tools for mapping in 2026 by G2's buyer's guide, earning the highest geocoding score (98%) and likelihood-to-recommend score (94%) in the lineup, recognized specifically for territory mapping and demographic analysis.

Key takeaways

  • G2, the world's largest software marketplace, named Maptitude among the six best GIS software tools for mapping in its 2026 buyer's guide
  • Maptitude earned the highest geocoding score (98%) and data capture score (97%) in the category lineup
  • The platform achieved a 94% Likelihood to Recommend score, the highest among the six tools compared
  • G2 recognized Maptitude as best for territory mapping and demographic analysis, citing its built-in data and accessibility for non-GIS-expert business analysts
  • Maptitude is available in both desktop and cloud-based (Maptitude Online) editions, serving Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and nonprofits
